title: Form 8-K disclosure draft
description: A draft Form 8-K cybersecurity disclosure. Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incidents) states the nature, scope and timing of the incident and its material impact or reasonably likely material impact. Item 8.01 (other events) describes an incident without a materiality determination and does not claim materiality. The company is fictional and no trading symbol is shown.

exerciseAid.description: Exercise-aid line printed on every governance document
examples: Exercise aid, not legal advice. Check the current rule and your counsel.
Ransomware on operational and administrative systems.
Systems at two of five plants, and file servers.

materialImpact.description: Material impact or reasonably likely material impact (Item 1.05) or current effect (Item 8.01)
examples: The incident has disrupted production and is reasonably likely to materially affect financial condition and results of operations.
Engaged outside experts, notified law enforcement and restored systems in stages.
The company is still assessing whether personal data was taken and will amend this report.
This report contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties.
